policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Singapore MFA destination guidance expressly records visa-free ordinary Singapore-passport visitor access for these destinations.
conditions: BA: up to 90 days within six months and no employment; KH: tourists up to 30 days; TN: up to 90 days; PA: up to 90 days; CU: up to 30 days; XK: visit or transit up to 90 days within six months.

KH e-Arrival is an immigration, health and customs declaration, not an ETA or visa. PA, CU and all other entries remain subject to passport, health, funds, onward-travel, security, carrier and final-admission conditions.
This is an ordinary Singapore-passport short-visitor baseline and excludes work, residence, extensions, special documents and individual admissibility.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: Ukraine electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Singapore MFA says Singaporeans can obtain Ukraine's electronic visa for ordinary short-visitor purposes.
conditions: The stated eVisa is valid for 30 days and can be single or double entry for tourism and other stated visitor purposes.

Singapore MFA also records a separate conditional visa-on-arrival route at Boryspil and Odesa airports. This policy records the expressly electronic route, not airport accessibility, martial-law, insurance, entry-point, work, residence, special-document or final-admission treatment.

application.label: Ukraine Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa web platform
steps: Use the official Ukraine MFA eVisa web platform before travel.
Apply with the ordinary Singapore passport intended for travel and retain the issued electronic visa.
Confirm current Ukrainian insurance, border-access and final-admission conditions before departure.

policies.title: Singapore ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Singapore MFA states that Bangladesh visa-on-arrival facilities are available to Singaporeans.
conditions: Singapore MFA warns that the facility can change at short notice and advises applying before arrival where practical.

This records the stated arrival-issuance facility only. It does not classify online application followed by paper submission at the Bangladesh High Commission as an eVisa, or work, business support, special documents, health, carrier or final-admission requirements.
